messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("chkShtSelector() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	self.view.params.values.chkShtId = payload['selection'][0]['value']['chkShtId'] if len(payload['selection']) > 0 else None
	
	return

system.perspective.print("chkItemSelected() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	dataTypeName = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('dataTypeName', system.kanoa.quality.config.getChecks({'chkItemId': payload['chkItemId']}))
	
	if dataTypeName.lower() == 'image':
		filters = self.view.custom.filters
		system.perspective.openPopup('Image Popup', 'kanoa/qds/images/chkItemImagesViewer', params={'values': {"chkItemId": payload['chkItemId'], 'startDate': filters['startDate'], 'endDate': filters['endDate'], 'editable': False}}, title = 'Images', resizable=True, showCloseIcon=True, draggable=True)
	else:
		self.openTrendChart(payload['chkItemId'])
	
	return

#	system.perspective.print("assetSelected() msg rcvd by chkShtDetail with %s"%payload)
	self.view.custom.filters.assetPath = payload['selection'][0]['path'] if len(payload['selection']) > 0 else None

	return

system.perspective.print("refresh() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	self.view.custom.displaySettings.showWide = True
	system.perspective.sendMessage('getTableData', {})
	
	return
